ObjectName.value: "Religious craftmanship in Coyoacán”

Categories.value: Religious art|Parish of San Juan Bautista, Coyoacán, Mexico City, Mexico|Self-published work|Reto Wikimedia Coyoacán Semana i Wiki Learning Tec de Monterrey Fall 2019

ImageDescription.value: Religious craftmanship is one of the most common things to see next to the doors of many catholic places in Mexico and Latin America. This picture, in particular, was taken in the entrance of Saint John Baptist church in the center of Coyoacan. In general, pieces are made by hand from wood, resembling different symbols such as “La Virgen de Guadalupe”, crosses, trees and various saints from the catholic church.
